answer: Use a fresh Argon2id puzzle per public key and epoch, salted with both so one proof cannot fund a key farm. Calibrate the target to 20 CPU-seconds and 256 MiB on published reference hardware: 100 fake keys then cost about 2,000 CPU-seconds and 25 GiB of parallel memory, while one honest key solves once. Required words: basalt, jetty, summit.
